liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Scarlet Begonias is described as ripping [12]
- **Dancing In The Street** (1 review): Reviewer ranks this Dancin' among the best ever [12]
- **Samson And Delilah** (1 review): Phil plays a descending bass line about 1:15 into Samson, repeating it [14]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): The closing run from Sugaree through Sugar Magnolia, Eyes and Sunshine Daydream is called very powerful and well played [12]

## Setlist highlights

- **Happy Birthday Keith**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1976-06-11.141709.sbd.miller.fixed.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 25 songs; 193 min; rated 4/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: This version fixes Looks Like Rain and numerous flaws from the previous source [1]
- **gd76-06-11.sbd.jmason.7824.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 190 min; rated 4.68/5 by 22 [4]. Said about its sound: Channels on this soundboard are reversed: piano and Mickey's cowbell appear on the left, Jerry on the right; Reviewer notes the channels are switched on this soundboard [13][19]
- **gd76-06-11.moore.minches.18387.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 24 songs; 196 min; rated 4.67/5 by 6 [6]. Said about its sound: This audience recording sounds pretty great, much better than the other audience source [21]
- **gd1976-06-11.141702.sbd.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 25 songs; 193 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer added several songs from this show to a personal compilation of Boston Music Hall June 9-12 shows [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1976-06-11.141709.sbd.miller.fixed.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Lineage: SBD > Master Reel (7in 7.5ips 1/2trk) > PCM; Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 > Samplitude… [1]. Also: Source uses PCM from Tim Dalton, with alternate patch reels covering all tape flips [1]
- **gd76-06-11.sbd.jmason.7824.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [4]
- **gd76-06-11.moore.minches.18387.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Mark Cohen, David Minches; source: Audience Recording: AKG 200Es [6]
- **gd1976-06-11.141702.sbd.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Lineage: SBD > Master Reel (7in 7.5ips 1/2trk) > PCM; Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 > Samplitude… [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Park Ave CDs: [Grateful Dead - Boston Music Hall, Boston, MA June 11, 1976 5LP RSD](https://parkavecds.shop/products/grateful-dead-boston-music-hall-boston-ma-6-11-76-rsd-2026) [23]
- Fan art by www.walmart.com: [Robot or human?](https://www.walmart.com/ip/Grateful-Dead-Boston-Music-Hall-Boston-MA-6-11-76-box-set/19644124312) [24]
- Poster by Iceman Video Games: [Grateful Dead - Boston Music Hall, Boston, Ma 6/11/76 (5Lp RSD26) Vinyl New](https://icemanvideogames.com/products/grateful-dead-boston-music-hall-boston-ma-6-11-76-5lp-rsd26-vinyl-new) [25]
- Fan art by Hana Gustafson: [Folk Americana Roots Hall of Fame and Rhino Records to Put on Grateful Dead Tribute Night Honoring 6/11/76 at Boston Mus](https://jambands.com/news/2026/05/08/folk-americana-roots-hall-of-fame-and-rhino-records-to-put-on-grateful-dead-tribute-night-honoring-6-11-76-at-boston-music-hall/) [26]
